cost_prediction: Within the same-scene rel1/rel3 observed GPU range unless a shader fix explains a signed change. Use per-pass ms, not frame time or occluded presented captures. Report every signed delta; single-sample ranges are not a statistical noise estimate. No build or compile overlaps.

cost_exceptions.rr_post: Parallel log-sum arithmetic can increase post-chain GPU ms; report the signed measured cost, no fabricated ms allowance.
cost_exceptions.bounds: Mip/UV/finite guards add small ALU; expected within observed noise. Corrected visibility can change ray traversal cost.
cost_exceptions.lifetime: Layer lifetime/FG/init changes predict no sustained per-pass GPU increase after warmup.

energy_prediction.measurement: Float full-image scene C before post: rrpost slot 2 dumps.json mean RGB, luminance 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B.
energy_prediction.rr_post: Log-domain geometric mean prevents intermediate product overflow/underflow and preserves ordinary rounding; no systematic pre-post C shift expected.
energy_prediction.alpha_mip: Only clamped out-of-range mip addresses change; corrected cutout visibility can add or remove occlusion. No global sign or percent can be derived.
energy_prediction.uv_bounds: Rejecting UV == 1 removes false edge hits; local sign depends on replaced sample. No systematic global shift expected.
energy_prediction.reprojection: Invalid history falls back to fresh/native. Previously black unavailable bounce regions may brighten; valid-history regions remain within noise. Uniform darkening is not expected.
energy_prediction.half_float: Finite positive tails above 65504 are capped (local downward delta); negative tails clamp to zero (upward). Avoided Inf and downstream rejection can change the observed sign. Ordinary radiance remains within noise.
energy_prediction.acceptance: Report signed absolute/percent deltas where a same-scene baseline exists. Never call lower energy an improvement. A material shift requires physically expected attribution or PT evidence, not an invented tolerance. S8 historical energy is unavailable in rel1/rel2; retain current floats and mark this comparison unavailable, not PASS.

visual: Inspect High cutout silhouettes and holes, Ultra water/edges, stock hair cards and face/neck shadows. No cross-run image A/B.
